name: The Beatles

whyMatters.en: Liverpool four-piece, active 1960–1970. Early British Invasion singles, then album-length writing and multitrack studio work with George Martin at EMI/Abbey Road.
whyMatters.zh: 利物浦四人组，活跃于 1960–1970。早期 British Invasion 单曲之后，转向专辑尺度写作，并在 EMI/Abbey Road 与 George Martin 合作多轨录音。

shortBio.en: Liverpool, 1960–1970. Lennon, McCartney, Harrison, Starr; EMI years from Invasion singles through Abbey Road.
shortBio.zh: 利物浦，1960–1970。Lennon、McCartney、Harrison、Starr；EMI 年代从 Invasion 单曲到《Abbey Road》。

body.en:
The Beatles formed in Liverpool in 1960 and settled as Lennon, McCartney, Harrison, and Starr by 1962. Early work centered on beat-group singles and Parlophone/EMI releases with producer George Martin.

I Want to Hold Your Hand (1963) reached US #1 in 1964. From Rubber Soul and Revolver through Sgt. Pepper, the White Album, and Abbey Road, sessions used multitrack tape, varispeed, edits, and orchestral overdubs. Live touring ended in 1966; studio records became the main release format.
body.zh:
The Beatles 于 1960 年在利物浦成立，1962 年前后固定为 Lennon、McCartney、Harrison、Starr。早期以 beat 组合单曲为主，在 Parlophone/EMI 与制作人 George Martin 合作。

《I Want to Hold Your Hand》（1963）于 1964 年登上美国榜冠军。从《Rubber Soul》《Revolver》到《Sgt. Pepper》、白专与《Abbey Road》，录音使用多轨磁带、变速、剪辑与管弦叠加。1966 年停止巡演后，录音室唱片成为主要发布形式。

body.en:
Early Beatles writing uses two guitars, bass, drums, and close vocal harmony in short verse/chorus forms.

Later albums keep the same four players but add tape edits, sitars, orchestras, and longer song structures. The shift is in arrangement and studio method, not lineup.
body.zh:
早期 Beatles 写作以双吉他、贝斯、鼓和紧密和声为主，歌曲多为短主歌/副歌结构。

后期专辑仍是同一四人，但加入磁带剪辑、西塔琴、管弦与更长的歌曲结构。变化在编曲与录音方法，不在阵容。

body.en:
From 1962 to 1970 the recording lineup stayed Lennon, McCartney, Harrison, and Starr.

Lennon and McCartney wrote most of the early hits. Harrison’s share of album tracks rose in the late 1960s. Starr’s drumming and occasional lead vocals stayed part of the group sound.
body.zh:
1962 至 1970 年，录音阵容保持为 Lennon、McCartney、Harrison、Starr。

早期热单多由 Lennon 与 McCartney 写作。1960 年代后期，Harrison 在专辑中的曲目份额上升。Starr 的鼓与偶尔的主唱也一直是乐队声音的一部分。

title.en: I Want to Hold Your Hand

body.en:
Released in the UK in late 1963 and in the US by Capitol in December 1963. It reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 in early 1964.

The song is short-form pop: dual lead vocals, handclap rhythm feel, and a clear chorus. US TV appearances around the same period widened the audience beyond the UK singles market.
body.zh:
1963 年末在英国发行，同年 12 月由 Capitol 在美国推出，1964 年初登上 Billboard Hot 100 冠军。

歌曲是短形式流行：双主唱、拍手节奏感与清楚的副歌。同期美国电视亮相扩大了听众范围。

body.en:
From Revolver (1966) onward, sessions at Abbey Road used four-track and later eight-track machines, tape loops, and varispeed.

A Day in the Life (1967) joins Lennon and McCartney sections with an orchestral build and a sustained final piano chord. After the 1966 tour stop, albums such as Sgt. Pepper and Magical Mystery Tour were made as studio projects rather than live-set documents.
body.zh:
自《Revolver》（1966）起，Abbey Road 录音使用四轨及后来的八轨机、磁带循环与变速。

《A Day in the Life》（1967）用管弦爬升和末尾延音钢琴和弦连接 Lennon 与 McCartney 的段落。1966 年停巡演后，《Sgt. Pepper》《Magical Mystery Tour》等作品以录音室项目而非现场曲目记录为主。

body.en:
Later rock songwriters often cite Lennon–McCartney harmony, middle-eight bridges, and album track sequencing.

Studio techniques from the EMI years—overdubs, tape edits, non-guitar timbres—also appear in psychedelic, progressive, and indie production after the 1960s.
body.zh:
后来的摇滚写作者常提到 Lennon–McCartney 和声、中八桥段与专辑曲目排序。

EMI 年代的录音手法——叠加、磁带剪辑、非吉他音色——也出现在 1960 年代之后的迷幻、progressive 与 indie 制作中。

body.en:
Press and documentary interviews are numerous. Useful lines describe who wrote which section and how a take was built in the studio.

McCartney’s remark about taking existing forms and adapting them matches the early cover-to-original path on the records.
body.zh:
媒体与纪录片访谈很多。有用的句子多描述谁写了哪一段、一条 take 如何在录音室搭成。

McCartney 关于取用已有形式再改写的说法，与唱片上从翻唱到原创的早期路径一致。

note.en: Recording lineup from Please Please Me through Let It Be / Abbey Road.
note.zh: 从《Please Please Me》到《Let It Be》/《Abbey Road》的录音阵容。
